senses.def: A town and civil parish with a town council in the Isle of Axholme, North Lincolnshire district, Lincolnshire, England (OS grid ref SE7803).
A community in Epworth-Great Salmonier local service district, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada.
A census-designated place in Fannin County, Georgia, named after Epworth, England.
An unincorporated community in White County, Illinois.
A city in Dubuque County, Iowa, named after Epworth, England.
An unincorporated community in Shelby County, Missouri, named after a local Methodist church and Epworth, England.
An unincorporated community in King William County, Virginia.
A dormitory town in Harare province, Zimbabwe, named after a Methodist mission.
